physical_capacity_comparison.unique_text_inference_capacity: 69.2 records/sec (~4.2 hours for 1,050,000 unique reviews on single CPU)
physical_capacity_comparison.cache_assisted_claim_comparison: The 42.19s claim represents warm-cache lookup (99.8% hit rate), whereas this test proves sustained physical throughput on 100% unique cold reviews.
physical_capacity_comparison.memory_stability_verdict: Strictly bounded <= 1 GB RAM. Peak RSS remained at 936.4 MB (87.6 MB below budget) during sustained 10,000-record execution.
